claude.country: Not reported (public YouTube corpus; authors affiliated in Sweden)

links.outcome: Whether cross-model disagreement flags human-verified ASR transcript errors for review
links.effect: Flagging positions with A ≤ 6 selected 28.6% of positions and captured 93.7% of HC errors; A ≤ 5 selected 18.1% and captured 81.9%. High-risk band error rate 56.3% vs 0.6% low-risk.
links.quote: Flagging tokens with A ≤ 6 selected 28.6% of positions and captured 93.7% of HC errors ( Figure 6B ).

links.outcome: Reference-free sampling of transcript regions for review to estimate real-world accuracy
links.effect: Shared-wrong errors where all 8 models agreed but were wrong: 78 of 4,914 HC errors (1.59%); recommends periodic random audit of high-confidence spans.
links.quote: Among 4,914 HC errors, 78 occurred at A = 8, corresponding to a shared-wrong rate of 1.59%.

links.outcome: Whether disagreement-based highlighting could focus clinician review on error-prone spans
links.effect: Concept validated only offline: high recall at modest PPV (56.3% at A ≤ 3; ~21% at A ≤ 6). No clinician usability study was conducted.
links.quote: At the broader A ≤ 6 threshold, the estimated PPV was approximately 21%, meaning that the majority of reviewed tokens would not contain verified errors.

unlisted_practices: Using multi-ASR cross-model disagreement as a reference-free triage signal for prioritizing human review of transcripts

links.effect: Vox Mini 93.3% identical; Gemini 92.7%; Whisper Turbo 92.5%; Speechmatics 91.7%; MedASR 72.7%; NeMo 72.4%.
links.quote: Vox Mini achieved the highest mean agreement (93.3%; SD = 3.2), whereas MedASR and NeMo QuartzNet showed substantially lower agreement (72.7%; SD = 12.2; and 72.4%; SD = 9.2, respectively).

links.effect: HC error rates rose from 0.6% (A ≥7; 71.5% positions) to 17.2% (A = 4–6; 25.8%) and 56.3% (A ≤ 3; 2.8%).
links.quote: Error rates increased monotonically across risk bands.

links.effect: Flagging A ≤ 6 selected 28.6% of positions and captured 93.7% of HC errors.
links.quote: Flagging tokens with A ≤ 6 selected 28.6% of positions and captured 93.7% of HC errors ( Figure 6B ).

links.effect: Among 4,914 HC errors, 78 occurred at A = 8; shared-wrong rate was 1.59%.
links.quote: Among 4,914 HC errors, 78 occurred at A = 8, corresponding to a shared-wrong rate of 1.59%.

links.effect: Low-risk proportions differed: 76.6% American (n=8), 75.9% Australian (n=8), 69.2% Singaporean (n=10); subgroup estimates were exploratory.
links.quote: Among higher-representation groups, low-risk proportions were 76.6% (American; n = 8), 75.9% (Australian; n = 8), and 69.2% (Singaporean; n = 10).
